## Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(infer)
```

### Visualising the data

```{r}
Goose_ph <-
  read_csv("R_rawdata(PH).csv")

Goose_ph |>
  ggplot(aes(y = pH,x = Feces_count)) + geom_point()+ labs(x = "Fecal Dropping Count", y = "pH", title = "Fecal Dropping Count vs pH") + theme_classic() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") 
```

```{r}
Goose_moisture <-
  read_csv("R_rawdata(SOILMOISTURE).csv")

Goose_moisture |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Feces_count,y = Moisture_mean)) + geom_point() + labs(x = "Fecal Dropping Count", y = "Mean moisture (%)" , title = "Fecal Dropping Count vs Mean Soil Moisture") + theme_classic() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") 
```

```{r}
Goose_CN<-
  read_csv("R_rawdata(CN).csv")

Goose_CN |>
  ggplot(aes(y = CN,x = Feces_count)) + geom_point()+ labs(x = "Fecal Dropping Count" , y = "Carbon Nitrogen Ratio", title = "Fecal Dropping Count vs Carbon Nitrogen Ratio") + theme_classic() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") 
  
```

```{r}
Goose_ph <-
  read_csv("R_rawdata(pH).csv")

Goose_ph |>
  ggplot(aes(y = pH,x = Moisture_mean)) + geom_point()+ labs(x = "Mean Soil Moisture (%)", y = "pH", title = "Mean Soil Moisture vs pH") + theme_classic() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") 
```

```{r}
Goose_ph |>
  ggplot(aes(y = pH,x = CN)) + geom_point()+ labs(x = "Carbon Nitrogen Ratio", y = "pH", title = "Carbon Nitrogen Ratio vs pH") + theme_classic() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") 
```

```{r}
Goose_ph |>
  ggplot(aes(y = Moisture_mean,x = CN)) + geom_point()+ labs(x = "Mean Soil Moisture (%)", y = "Carbon Nitrogen Ratio", title = "Carbon Nitrogen Ratio vs Mean Soil Moisture") + theme_classic() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") 
```

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(Goose_ph, aes(y = pH,x = Feces_count)) + geom_point()+ labs(x = "Feces Count", y = "pH", title = "Feces count vs pH") + theme_classic() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") 

p2 <- ggplot(Goose_ph, aes(y = CN,x = Feces_count)) + geom_point()+ labs(x = "Feces Count" , y = "Carbon Nitrogen Ratio)", title = "Feces count vs Carbon Nitrogen Ratio") + theme_classic() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") 

p3 <- ggplot(Goose_moisture, aes(x = Feces_count,y = Moisture_mean)) + geom_point() + labs(x = "Feces Count", y = "Mean moisture (%)" , title = "Mean Soil Moisture vs Feces count") + theme_classic() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") 

final_plot<-(p1 + p2 + p3) 

ggsave("ggplot_combined.png", plot = final_plot, width = 8, height = 6)
```

### Regression Analysis

#### pH

```{r}
obs_fit_ph <-
  Goose_ph |>
  specify(pH ~ Feces_count) |>
  calculate(stat = "slope")

obs_fit_ph
```

Response: reproductive_success (numeric) (ph) Explanatory: mating_success (numeric) (feces)

```{r}
null_dist_ph <-
  Goose_ph |>
  specify(pH ~ Feces_count) |>
  hypothesize(null = "independence") |>
  generate(reps = 10000, type = "permute") |>
  calculate(stat = "slope")

null_dist_ph
```

```{r}
null_dist |>
  visualize() +
  shade_p_value(obs_stat = obs_fit_ph, direction = "two-sided")

null_dist |>
  get_p_value(obs_stat = obs_fit_ph, direction = "two-sided")
```

Observed fit ph:

```         
-0.000325
```

p:

```         
0.847
```

### Covariance analysis

#### pH vs CN

```{r}
C_ph_CN <-
  Goose_ph |>
  specify(pH ~ CN) |>
  calculate(stat = "correlation")

C_ph_CN
```

```{r}
null_dist_pHCN <-
  Goose_ph |>
  specify(pH ~ CN) |>
  hypothesize(null = "independence") |>
  generate(reps = 10000, type = "permute") |>
  calculate(stat = "correlation")
```

```{r}
null_dist_pHCN |>
  visualize() +
  shade_p_value(obs_stat = C_ph_CN, direction = "two-sided")

null_dist_pHCN |>
  get_p_value(obs_stat = C_ph_CN, direction = "two-sided")
```

Observed Correlation: -0.489

p: 0.0222
